title: Consciousness fades with complexity and never switches off

statements.text: Consciousness may never switch off entirely as organic complexity falls, fading through flies, insects, plants and amoebae, and on constitutive panpsychism the fading continues into inorganic matter, with electrons and quarks having extremely rudimentary forms of consciousness.

sources.quote: it is equally possible that the light of consciousness never switches off entirely, but rather fades as organic complexity reduces, through flies, insects, plants and amoeba
